# Brahim Bousnguar

> Senior E-Commerce Integration Consultant with 9+ years of experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris/CCv2), MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, and Salesforce integration. Based in France, working with enterprise clients across 15+ countries. Bilingual English/French.

Key facts:

- Current role: MuleSoft Integration Specialist at Roche Bobois (since January 2025) — API-led integration architecture, DataWeave, Salesforce CRM data flows.
- Previous: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant at Miele (2022–2024, cloud-native CCv2 migration + SAP BTP Kyma microservices); Technical Lead at BYK (2018–2021, multi-country B2B platform, Hybris 6.7 → CCv2); SAP Hybris Integration Specialist at SEB Group (2016–2018, multi-brand platform).
- Certifications: GitHub Copilot (GH-300) (Sep 2026); SAP Certified — Solution Architect — SAP Customer Experience (Mar 2026); SAP Certified — Positioning SAP Customer Experience Solutions (Mar 2026); SAP Certified — Business User — SAP Commerce Cloud (Mar 2025); SAP Certified Development Professional — SAP Commerce Cloud Developer (2023); SAP Certified Associate — Hybris Commerce Business Analyst 6.3 (2018). Currently pursuing MuleSoft Anypoint Platform certifications. The 2026 and 2025 SAP certifications are verifiable on Credly: https://www.credly.com/users/brahim-bousnguar. The GitHub Copilot certification is verifiable on Microsoft Learn: https://learn.microsoft.com/api/credentials/share/en-us/BrahimBousnguar-7690/20B68101386B5A?sharingId=9C9C9C1DC7CAD24F
- AI-augmented workflow: daily use of GitHub Copilot, Ollama-based LLM CLI tooling, Claude, and OpenAI Codex CLI. Side projects around MCP servers, local LLM benchmarking, and AI coding-assistant cost tracking.
- Education: State Engineer in Computer Science & Business Intelligence, INSEA Rabat (2015).

## Projects

Side projects, one page each (English; French versions under https://heybrahim.com/fr/projets/). Markdown at the same URL with `.md`.

<!-- projects:start -->
- [mulewatch](https://heybrahim.com/projects/mulewatch.html) (2026-09-08): mulewatch is an open-source, read-only MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor or any MCP client read live and archived MuleSoft Anypoint logs, list deployed apps, API Manager instances and Exchange assets. Markdown: https://heybrahim.com/projects/mulewatch.md
- [Meterlex](https://heybrahim.com/projects/meterlex.html) (2026-07-30): Meterlex reads the session logs of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Ollama and Copilot CLI, prices every model call at the public API rate and compares it with what your subscriptions cost. Local-first, token counts only. Markdown: https://heybrahim.com/projects/meterlex.md
- [AI Models Costs](https://heybrahim.com/projects/ai-models-costs.html) (2026-06-15): A static React dashboard comparing public API prices across American, Chinese, European and specialist AI providers, for text, reasoning, image, audio, video, embeddings and more, normalized to USD per 1M tokens where possible. Markdown: https://heybrahim.com/projects/ai-models-costs.md
- [Termo Track](https://heybrahim.com/projects/termo-track.html) (2026-06-13): Termo Track listens to ThermoPro Bluetooth sensors, stores readings in SQLite, shows live temperature and humidity in a React dashboard next to the outside weather, and exposes it all to AI clients through MCP. Local-first, no cloud account. Markdown: https://heybrahim.com/projects/termo-track.md
- [MacBook MCP Server](https://heybrahim.com/projects/macbook-mcp-server.html) (2026-03-26): A small Python MCP server that exposes a MacBook's CPU, memory, disk, battery, network, GPU and top processes as MCP tools and a resource, over stdio or streamable HTTP for remote access through Tailscale. Markdown: https://heybrahim.com/projects/macbook-mcp-server.md
<!-- projects:end -->

## Notes

Technical notes (English), newest first. Plain-text Markdown of each is at the same URL with `.md`; everything in one file: https://heybrahim.com/llms-full.txt

<!-- notes:start -->
- [The official MuleSoft MCP server can't read your logs, so I built one that can](https://heybrahim.com/notes/mulewatch-anypoint-logs-mcp.html) (2026-09-18): mulewatch is an open-source, read-only MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor or any MCP client read live and archived MuleSoft Anypoint logs. The trick is finding the right replica in the Monitoring Archive in one call instead of hundreds. Markdown: https://heybrahim.com/notes/mulewatch-anypoint-logs-mcp.md
